label: Firing apertures
copy: The openings were positioned to give machine guns a field of fire across the coast. Pillboxes were placed so their fields of fire could overlap.

label: A defended coast
copy: In the 1930s, British defences anticipated a coastal attack on Singapore. The surrounding shoreline and infrastructure have since changed dramatically.

label: Pasir Panjang
copy: The pillbox lay within the area guarded by the 1st Battalion of the Malay Regiment during the Battle of Pasir Panjang in February 1942.
